text:
nora: Quick sync  BlueCrest wants to convert the POC to a paid pilot. They returned MSA/DPA with redlines and requested Net60 + customer HSM. Need decision on prepay, POC SLA language, and who can sign the order form. cc @ben @harish

ben: Procurement: For short pilots we usually require prepay or an approved PO. Net60 is OK only with credit sign-off. Please ask for remit address and tax ID on the PO.

harish: Legal: Their redlines remove our audit rights and add mandatory HSM. For a 2-week POC we should: 1) offer KMS attestation instead of customer HSM; 2) add a one-page POC addendum that scopes audit to an attestation and sets data deletion (30 days). I can draft this today.

finance-bot: Finance flag: Net60 requires credit review. For trials acceptable terms: Net45 + 50% prepay. Provide billing contact + W-9 to billing@redwood.example.

evie: SE: POC will run on dedicated infra, expected peak ~50 rps. We shouldn't promise prod SLOs. Recommend "POC performance objective" (non-binding) e.g., median latency <150ms and include a short perf annex. I'll run a perf test Monday.

nora: Proposed package: 1) 1-page POC addendum limiting audit + 30d data deletion; 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45; 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) median 150ms; 4) E-sign allowed with PO attached. Anyone object?

ben: Sounds good. I'll request PO and remit details to procurement@redwood.example. We'll collect tax id and W-9.

harish: I'll remove mandatory HSM for POC and circulate the addendum. Keep HSM as production-only.

finance-bot: Once we have billing contact and PO# we can proceed. If they insist on Net60 escalate for credit exception.

nora: Action items recap: @harish draft addendum; @evie run perf Monday; @ben collect PO + remit/W-9; finance will approve Net45+50% prepay. I'll own e-sign envelope and route once addendum ready. :thumbsup:

nora: Order form snippet I'll send:
```
Term: POC (2 weeks)
Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 from invoice date
SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding)  median latency target 150ms
Data: Data deletion within 30 days after POC
```

nora: If no one objects to prepay or the non-binding SLA I'll send to the customer and request PO + billing details.
